subject: Three-week bridge plan for execution owners
body:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentHQ <hr-consultant@talenthq.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Three-week bridge plan for execution owners

Team —

Following our leadership sync this morning, I drafted a short three-week bridge plan that clarifies ownership for critical delivery risks ahead of the QBR. The goal is to give each execution owner a clear, lightweight runbook: what to own, who to escalate to, and the two most important metrics to move between now and the QBR.

High-level ask: please review the attached one-pager and provide: 1) the owner for each bullet, 2) any gating dependencies, and 3) any ask you want in the leadership readout.

Key windows:
- Week 0 (this week): confirm owners & blockers; quick fixes only.
- Week 1: mitigation runs; vendor/procure escalations if needed.
- Week 2: stabilization and QBR-ready metrics.

I've attached bridge_plan_v2.pdf and a short QBR checklist. I will consolidate feedback and push a final cascade email by Friday EOD (11/13).

Thanks —
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, TalentHQ <hr-consultant@talenthq.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Three-week bridge plan for execution owners

Maya —

Thanks for this. Quick notes after a skim:
- On the infra throughput item, can we explicitly call out the fallback policy (route to dedicated pool) and who owns activating it? I propose tagging Marcus but since he's not on this thread I'll own the coordination.
- For the eval regression check, add a 24-hour freeze window before the QBR snapshot (so we don’t pull a last-minute model swap).
- Suggest we add a single slide in the leadership readout that lists open risks with an explicit remediation ETA.

I'll add inline comments in Drive. Two small asks: can we make the metrics column numeric targets (not just direction), and can Marissa confirm whether finance will accept the adjusted spend estimates in row 4?

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Chief of Staff, Product | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Three-week bridge plan for execution owners

Maya / Jonas —

Appreciate the concise framing. A few tactical proposals from my side:

1) Cascade cadence: I recommend two short touchpoints per week for the execution owners (15 min standup, 30 min review) and a single Friday morning health snapshot that the leadership team can consume.

2) Escalation matrix: please add a small table mapping severity -> owner -> escalation path. Sample:
   - Sev1 (service-impacting): On-call infra lead -> Jonas -> exec on-call
   - Sev2 (quality/regression): Model steward -> Marissa -> Product Ops

3) HR note: we've flagged two role coverage gaps for the analytics team. I asked TalentHQ to share a shortlist of contractors who can step in for 3–6 weeks; cc'd them for visibility.

I’ll take ownership of the health snapshot template and will drop a starter slide into Drive by end of day today.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Three-week bridge plan for execution owners

All —

I've incorporated Jonas and Soojin's suggestions into v2 (attached). A few clarifications:
- Finance confirmed the provisional spend numbers for transient capacity but asked that we flag any >10% delta ahead of the QBR.
- Marcus will be the infra activation lead; Jonas will handle coordination.
- TalentHQ sent an initial contractor shortlist (cc'd). Sarah from Acme will review the performance checklist with her analytics lead on Friday.

Next steps:
- Maya: consolidate and send cascade by Friday EOD (11/13).
- Soojin: share the Friday health snapshot template when you drop it into Drive.
- Jonas: confirm the fallback activation playbook is in runbook form by 11/15.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Program Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
